title: Matthew 24:22-25: days of the Son of Man, lightning, suffering
summary: A passage labelled Matthew 24:22-25 (Greek header Μαθθαῖον 24:22-25): the days will come when you long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, do not run after those who say 'Look there!', the Son of Man will be like lightning across the sky, but first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

text.text: 22 And He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
23 “They will say to you, ‘Look there! Look here!’ Do not go away, and do not run after them.
24 “For just like the lightning, when it flashes out of one part of the sky, shines to the other part of the sky, so will the Son of Man be in His day.
25 “But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
